title: Delete my account can be undone by a copy that was already sending
what: When a member taps Delete my account while the background copy is still sending (for example right after opening the app, or during a first copy of a long history), the copy keeps sending its remaining batches after the server has deleted the saved workouts. For an account that is also a gym owner's, trainer's or older gym-sync member's sign-in, the server keeps the sign-in, so those batches are saved again. The member is told the copy was deleted, but part or all of it is back on our server.
expected: Delete my account first stops and waits for any running copy, then deletes, so nothing is saved after the delete.
who: members whose sign-in is also a gym owner, trainer or older gym-sync account
how_often: rare: only when a copy is sending at the moment of the delete
fix_line: Pause the background copy and wait for it to finish before asking the server to delete, and stop it for good before saying done
rejected_why: Fixed on main: deleteAccount now calls stopWatchingCloudCopy() and haltCopyAndWait() before apiAccountDelete and refuses if a copy is still running (apps/mobile/src/cloud/account.ts:203-208; copySync.ts:291-305; copyNow/drain also return while paused). Fix ships in 0.80.0 (whatsNew.ts:80-84); whether members already have it on Play is G-0013 (unsure). Keep open as waiting-for-release, not as a code fault.

title: Update note says complaints reach only the owner, but the front desk can now get them too
what: The 14 Nov update note, still readable in Settings under What's new, says complaints still reach only the owner. Since the server change of 15 Nov a member on the newest app can send a complaint to Gym admin, which is the owner and the front desk. The note that explains this is parked and not shown yet, so the old line reads as true today.
expected: The note says who can read a complaint as it works today, or the newer note is shown as soon as any member can pick Gym admin.
who: owners who trust that complaints are private to them
how_often: every complaint a member on the newest app sends to Gym admin
fix_line: Reword the 14 Nov line, or publish the parked note about who reads a message
rejected_why: The 'Gym admin = you and the front desk' note is no longer parked: it moved into the shown ADMIN_NEWS 2026-11-25 entry (whatsNew.ts:38-50) with the admin deploy; the old 14 Nov line (whatsNew.ts:203) stays in history but the newer note above it now says how it works

title: No test proves sign-out is held while saved items still wait to send
what: Staff and sign-in turns the sign-out button off while things saved on this device have not reached the server, so a payment is not lost. No automated test saves something offline and then tries to sign out.
expected: A test saves a payment with no internet, opens Staff and sign-in, and checks sign-out is off with the wait-for-All-sent words, then on once sent.
how_often: every sign-out with a weak connection
fix_line: Add one end-to-end test for sign-out with items waiting
rejected_why: offline3.spec.mjs J34c (:125-169) saves a check-in offline, opens Staff & sign-in, checks '1 saved on this device is still waiting to send' and Sign out disabled (:159-160), then enabled after 'All sent' (:165-168); the guard PeopleScreen.tsx:481 counts any unsent item, so a payment would not differ

title: Nothing checks what a member sees of the sale note, dues and cancel reason
what: No test opens the member app after a sale with a note, a part payment or a cancelled receipt, to check that the gym note, the cancel reason, the taker phone number and other members dues stay hidden, and that the due shows in the app own words.
expected: A test reads the member app after these sales and checks what is shown and what stays hidden.
how_often: every sale with a note or a part payment
fix_line: Add a member app check after a sale with a note, a part payment and a cancel
rejected_why: The member's views are allow-lists (member_membership sends only plan name, dates, PT counts, trainer: 0055_pass_members.sql:101-123) so the note, cancel reason and taker phone cannot reach the app; SQL tests assert no money/phone in them (tests/0023:66-68, tests/0057:34) and pay.test.mjs:284-302 proves a member sees only their own due, without memberId; only a full sale-to-app run is missing (S3 at most)

title: No test proves a member sees only their own help questions
what: Nothing checks that Your questions shows only the questions sent from this install, never another member's, that they are not shown to gym staff, that they are gone after an erase, or that replies survive a changed install id.
expected: A test that asks with one install's details and gets none of another install's questions, and one that erases and sees an empty list.
fix_line: Add a test that two installs never see each other's questions and that erase empties the list
rejected_why: The server test proves only the asking install with its secret gets its questions, and another install or a wrong secret gets none (deploy/panel/help.test.mjs:163-183); erase dropping the saved questions is tested (apps/mobile/test/onboarding/dataActions.test.ts:411-420). Left untested is only replies after a changed install id (S3)

title: Two Workout tab cards and the newest What's new tell a member under 18 that signing in keeps their workouts safe
what: The card 'Your workouts are only on this phone. Confirm your phone number once, and MettleUp keeps them safe in your account', the card 'Backups now go to your MettleUp account. Sign in to keep your workouts safe' and the 0.80.0 What's new line all promise a backup after sign-in. None of them looks at age, but the app saves nothing on MettleUp's server for a member whose age is under 18. Such a member signs in, believes the workouts are safe, and loses them with the phone.
expected: A member under 18 is not shown the backup promise, or is told plainly that workouts stay only on this phone.
fix_line: Hide both cards and soften the What's new line for members under 18, using the same age check the backup uses
rejected_why: The harm claimed (member under 18 signs in and believes workouts are safe) cannot happen: accountStore.signIn refuses a profile under 18 before any sign-in and shows 'Saving workouts on MettleUp is only for members aged 18 and older. Your workouts stay on this phone.' Both cards show only to signed-out members, so the worst left is a promise card that leads to that plain refusal (wording nit). The signed-in case is G-0141.

title: If MettleUp's WhatsApp check line stops working, every new member is stuck in a Start again loop and MettleUp is not told
what: The main way into the app is now Continue with your phone number, which depends on one MettleUp WhatsApp number receiving the member's message. If that line stops receiving (account blocked, token expired, number lost with the laptop or phone), the waiting screen only offers Open WhatsApp and Start again, and ends with 'The check ran out of time. Tap Start again.' It never suggests Try another way or the gym code, and nothing tells MettleUp that checks are failing.
expected: After a check runs out of time, the screen offers the gym code and Try another way, and repeated failed checks alert MettleUp.
who: every new member using phone sign-in
how_often: whenever the WhatsApp line is down
fix_line: Offer the other ways in after a timed-out check and alert MettleUp when checks keep timing out
rejected_why: Members are not stuck: the phone view always has a Back row to the main welcome, where Try another way and the gym code are (WelcomeScreen.tsx:582 BackRow -> goView('main')), and the Google way is shown below it (WelcomeScreen.tsx:597). Only the 'MettleUp is not told when checks fail' part stands, as a smaller S3 alerting gap.

title: A gym that pays MettleUp during its free trial loses its unused trial days, and a plan change carries the old paid days onto the new plan
what: When HQ confirms a payment, the paid month or year is counted from today or the current paid-until date; the free trial's end is ignored. A gym paying on day 3 of its trial loses the rest of the trial, while HQ's own confirm line says the paid time starts when the trial ends. A change of plan also moves all the days already paid onto the new plan: a gym with months of Starter left that pays one Pro month gets Pro for all of them, and a Pro gym that pays one Starter month drops to Starter at once for the rest of its paid Pro time. The later billing step that fixes both is not live.
expected: Paid time starts when the trial ends, and a plan change is priced or timed so neither MettleUp nor the gym loses paid days, with HQ's line showing the same date the server sets.
how_often: every gym that pays during its trial or switches plan
fix_line: Count paid time from the trial's end and handle a plan switch as its own case, as the next billing step already does, then make that step live
rejected_why: Mostly fixed by 0063, which is live (LIVE-STATE.md:14): HQ's manual Confirm now goes through the 'renew' form (0063_gym_checkout.sql:294-299), which starts from the trial end (_paid_from, :249) and lets running Pro finish before a Starter switch (:255-261). Only a leftover stands: a Starter gym with months left that pays one Pro month gets Pro for all of them (renew sets plan=pro, :256), and HQ warns about the plan change first (apps/hq/public/logic.js:867). MettleUp's loss, rare: S3.

title: A member can log made-up workouts in the app and win a challenge's free membership days
what: Workout and kg challenges count the workouts members log in their own app, with no check that they came to the gym that day. When the challenge ends, the server adds the free days to every winner's plan by itself. A member who taps in 3 workouts a day from home, or types huge weights, reaches the goal and gets free days of paid membership. The workout-code check on the member page already matches workouts against check-ins for this reason, but challenges do not.
expected: Only workouts on days the gym saw the member count toward a challenge with a prize, or the owner approves winners before free days are added.
who: owners who run a challenge with free days
fix_line: Count a workout toward a prize challenge only on a day with a check-in, or hold the free days until the owner confirms the winners
rejected_why: The evidence cites 0047, but 0048 (applied live 3 Nov 2026) replaced _challenge_results so a finished challenge's winners are marked 'confirm', not 'pending' (0048:396), and free days are added only when the owner presses Give in owner_confirm_challenge_reward (0048:412-432); 0091 keeps that. The finding's own expected fix (owner approves winners first) is already live

title: While payments are in test mode, a test payment for a shop order makes the desk hand over the goods for free
what: The server's own rule says a test-mode payment must never let the desk hand over shop goods. But the check the desk runs before Collected counts any link found paid, test or live. A member who pays a shop order on a test payment page (anyone can) makes the desk read that the member has just paid Rs X online, do not take money, tap Collected again to hand it over. The words never say test mode. The gym gives the goods and no money ever arrives.
expected: A test-mode payment is never treated as money: the desk is told it was a test and takes the money as usual.
how_often: every shop order paid on a test payment page while test mode is on
fix_line: Leave test-mode payments out of the check before Collected, or say plainly that it was a test
rejected_why: The desk check does filter test payments: useBeforeDeskMoney returns paid only when isRealMoney(paid) (apps/dashboard/src/crm/pay/useDeskPay.ts:100; isRealMoney = testMode !== true, logic/joinPay.ts:50-51), and requestView marks a test-mode company payment testMode (deploy/panel/pay.js:298). So a test payment gives null and justPaidOnline is never shown for it.

title: A member who types an age of 10 to 17 can sign in and have their age and body weight kept on MettleUp's server
what: The profile accepts any age from 10. Signing in with Google is offered to every member with no age line, and the saved copy then sends the profile, including the age, and the body weight to MettleUp's server. Nothing checks the age, so the server knowingly holds health-type data of someone who said they are under 18. The privacy notice and terms say MettleUp is only for people 18 or over and that such data is deleted once MettleUp learns of it.
expected: Ages under 18 are refused (or sign-in is blocked for them), or the saved copy is not kept for a profile under 18, matching the notice.
who: members under 18 who sign in with Google
how_often: every under-18 member who signs in
fix_line: Make 18 the lowest age the app accepts, or stop the saved copy for a profile under 18.
rejected_why: Fixed in 0.80.0 (owner release 25 Nov): sign-in refuses a profile under 18 (accountStore.ts:139-145) and the background copy sends nothing for one (copySync.ts:128-133, 161, 317); Google sign-in also has an 18+ tick (WelcomeGoogle.tsx:250). Leftover: copies saved before 0.80.0, or before the age was lowered, are not removed from the server

rejected_why: Not built is correct (no code found), but the private backlog honestly labels it Planned and no public text (help articles, panel pages, legal pages) mentions it, so the finding's own expected result ('or no public text mentions it until it is built') already holds: no fault, just a planned item.

title: The owner's inbox page and its feature backlog are missing from the feature list
what: The backlog calls the owner inbox page and the backlog with comments Live. A script that builds this page exists, but the feature list has no row for it, so nothing in this audit checks it. It was not driven here, so whether it works today is unknown.
expected: Every tool the owner uses has a row in the feature list, with its checks.

title: Notes plan a join-by-email match, but it is not in the app
what: The backlog says a member who signs in with Google is offered their gym when the email matches the gym's member list. The add-member form has an email box, but nothing in the member app or the server looks a gym up by email.
expected: The match exists, or the backlog says it is still only a plan.
fix_line: Keep it as a plan in the backlog, or build the match with the ask-first step
rejected_why: The note (owner-inbox part03:516-521) is a 29 Oct proposal written as future ('One line about the join match goes in when we build it'); no backlog row calls it Live, no screen hint promises it (grep finds no 'join in one tap'), and the gym match that shipped is by phone number instead (F203, 0100_gym_added_you.sql:146-158). Expected 'or the backlog says it is still only a plan' already holds.

title: Deleting a saved workout, its photo limit and its load errors are never tested
what: No test taps 'Delete workout', sees 'Delete this workout?', or checks the workout and its records leave the feed. No test sees 'Workout not found', 'Couldn't load this workout', a failed delete, the 'needs at least one set' line, or the fourth-photo limit.
expected: A device test deletes a saved workout and checks the feed and Records; tests make the page read and the delete fail and see the right words.
fix_line: Add device tests for deleting a saved workout and its failure words
rejected_why: The lead claim is wrong: qa/uat-h.yaml:376-440 (run as part UH, run-device-qa.sh:1593) taps 'Delete workout', sees 'Delete this workout?', presses Delete and checks the day and month count on Calendar and the Profile count go back. What is really untested is smaller: Records after a delete, 'Workout not found' (session/[id].tsx:211), a failed read or delete, the one-set line and the fourth-photo limit.

title: The widget start, its confirm screen and its retry are never shown in a test
what: Only the rule that decides start, resume, confirm or Workout tab is tested. No phone test taps the Today widget, opens a keyless link to see 'Start Push 1?' with 'Start Push 1' and 'Not now', double taps it, or sees 'Couldn't start' with Try again. Reopening after Android closed the app mid-workout is not tested either.
expected: A phone test opens a widget link and a keyless link for a real routine and checks one workout starts, the confirm screen, Not now and a failed start.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the widget start, the Start confirm screen and a failed start
rejected_why: uat-wp4b.sh:262-284 drives the real widget Start (uk1), the keyed Start (uk3) and a spent-key link that shows 'Start <routine>?' + 'Not now' (uat-k4.yaml:10-16); only 'Couldn't start'+Try again, double tap and reopen-after-kill stay untested (uk4 is non-blocking '|| true')

title: The Hevy or Strong pick on the welcome screen is never tested
what: Only the card's sentence and when the card may show are tested. No test picks Hevy on the welcome screen and checks the import opens once after setup, never again, and not after a backup restore. No test taps 'From Strong' and checks the Strong import opens.
expected: A phone test picks an app on the welcome screen and sees its import open once; small tests cover the pick being dropped on a restore and taken back.
fix_line: Add a welcome-pick phone test and the restore case
rejected_why: uat-e.yaml (part 2, U-M2) taps 'From Hevy' on the welcome, then Start training, and asserts the Hevy import opened by itself ('Choose Hevy file'); store-a.yaml:38-80 does the same. Still untested: it not opening a second time, the pick dropped on a backup restore, and 'From Strong' (only seen, not tapped: phase1-a.yaml:48-65)

title: No test proves gym mates stop seeing a member's workouts when sharing is off or Plus ends
what: The tests check what goes into the shared workout list (bio, workout names, best sets, no photos or body weight), but none checks the switch-off case or the end of MettleUp Plus: that the bio, the workout names and recent workouts stop reaching gym mates.
expected: A test turns 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' off, and another ends Plus, and checks that nothing more is shared and the old shared workouts can no longer be opened by gym mates.
fix_line: Add a test for sharing switched off and for Plus ending, checking gym mates see nothing new
rejected_why: Switch-off IS tested: mateShare.test.ts:57-88 (off = nothing sent, stop sent until it lands) and supabase/tests/0040_gym_mate_profiles.sql:114-139 (name off closes the profile; stop removes every shared workout). Plus does not gate mate sharing at all (PaidFeature list, packages/theme/src/memberPlan.ts:56), so there is no Plus-end path to test; if a journey promises one, that is a journey wording mismatch, not a missing test

title: No test checks that a gym member with an active plan gets older charts and the watch free
what: The Plus test checks the locked 12-month chart for a free member and the gym unlock words, but never opens Charts or the watch offer as a gym member whose plan is active. A gym member could be shown the Plus note or a paid watch offer and no test would fail.
expected: A test opens 12 months of Charts and the watch offer as a gym member with an active plan and checks no Plus note or price shows.
fix_line: Add the gym-member case to the Plus phone test for Charts and the watch
rejected_why: The Charts screen asks chartAllowed (stats.tsx:101-112), and limitsFlag.test.ts:100-112 checks it allows all-time charts for a gym member (why 'gym'); memberAccess gives a running-plan gym member all:true (memberPlanRules.test.ts:98-106) and canUse is just a.all for every feature incl. watch (packages/theme/src/memberPlan.ts:178-180). So a wrong Plus note for a gym member would fail tests; only the screens themselves are not driven as a gym member

title: Nothing tests that old shared workouts are cleared or that non-sharing members stay off Training progress
what: The year-of-workouts test checks the share, its limits, who may read it, and that turning sharing off or leaving deletes it. No test checks that a member who shares nothing new for 90 days drops off, that a member who never shared is not listed, or that sharing again after turning it off sends the year afresh.
expected: A test ages a share past 90 days and checks it is gone, and checks that a never-sharing member is not listed.
fix_line: Add an aged-share case and a never-shared case to the progress tests
rejected_why: The 90-day drop IS tested: supabase/tests/0050_trainer_view.sql:175-177 ages a share to 91 days, reads owner_trainer_members (the live list, 0050 migration:251-252) and checks it is gone; only small gaps remain (no never-sharing member in gym A, so '3count' :96-98 cannot prove non-sharers stay off; re-share-after-off not checked)

title: The one-year delete of feedback messages is never tested
what: The privacy notice promises feedback is deleted after a year. The run that deletes it, and the run that sorts messages, have no test, so nothing proves old messages really go.
expected: A test puts in a message older than a year and one newer, runs the delete, and checks only the old one is gone.
fix_line: Add a test for the feedback delete and sort runs
rejected_why: The one-year delete really runs in the HQ Worker's nightly cron (deploy/hq/web.js:390-396, called at worker.js:188) and is tested with one old and one new message in deploy/hq/hq.test.mjs:663-672; only the hand-run copy in scripts/feedback.py:69-71 and its 'mark' sort are untested

title: A member's phone is told 'all fine' with no dates, so nobody learns why birthday, welcome and plan reminders never come
what: The reminder data for a member's phone answers 'ok' even when the member's number was never proven at a QR check-in, the first name in the app does not match the gym's list, or two members share the number. The birthday, joining date and plan are simply left empty and the reason is thrown away. The phone cannot show the member 'check in once at the desk to get your reminders', so the member silently gets no birthday wish, welcome or plan-ending reminder.
expected: When a member cannot get the gym's reminders, their phone is told why and shows one plain line on how to fix it.
how_often: every member without a proven number or with a name mismatch
fix_line: Hand the phone the reason (no check-in yet, name differs, shared number) and show it under the gym reminders switch
rejected_why: member_auto_reminders does drop the reason (0029_auto_reminders.sql:145-164, still the live definition), but the same reasons reach the phone through member_membership (0023:21-26), which the phone already reads, and MembershipCard shows them with the fix ('Check in once to link your membership', name/shared-number/roster lines: shop/membership.ts:121-131). The member is told why; only the link to reminders is unstated.

title: 26 gym tab screens have no test that loads them, and the few screen tests only look for words in the code
what: The bag, pay panels, check-in, messages, membership, plan request and 20 more gym tab files are never loaded by any test. The tests that do touch the gym tab screens read the code as text and look for words, so a screen that crashes or shows the wrong thing still passes.
expected: The money and check-in screens at least are drawn in a test and their buttons pressed.
fix_line: Add drawn-screen tests for the pay, bag and check-in screens first
rejected_why: The quick tests are text-only (r77GymTab.test.ts:37-46), but the two screens the finding names are drawn on an emulator by device UAT run from qa/run-device-qa.sh: check-in is opened and 'Check in' pressed (qa/uat-rel-7-gym-checkin.yaml:17-27, checkin-f1/f2), and the pay panel's UPI QR and 'Pay by UPI app' are shown and photographed (qa/uat-rel-f79-pay.yaml:4-44). 'Never loaded by any test' is wrong; what is left is a smaller gap (no quick render test, pay button not pressed).

title: Home-screen widget buttons can be hard to read when the app is in light mode
what: The widgets always have a dark background, but their label and action words (Start, Resume, Check in, Open) take the app's current accent colour. In light mode that accent is made darker so it reads on white, so on the dark widget it reads poorly: about 3 to 1 for MettleUp's own orange, and worse for a gym with a dark brand colour. The words are small (11 and 13 points), which need 4.5 to 1.
expected: Words on the widget are easy to read whatever the phone's theme and the gym's colour.
who: members who use light mode and add a widget
fix_line: Always give the widgets the dark-mode accent colour, or check its contrast against the widget's dark background
rejected_why: widgetLook() reads `color` imported as `darkColor` (widgets.ts:41, 214-215), the always-dark copy that brandTokens.ts:231-235 keeps in step with the gym's DARK palette, not the light-mode accent (#AD420D in tokens.ts:101), so light mode does not change the widget's words.
